{{Quote|Artoo, get us off this autopilot! It's gonna get us both killed!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
An '''autopilot''' (or '''auto-pilot''') was an on board [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system on most [[Starship/Legends|starships]] which piloted the vessel on a predetermined trajectory that could be plotted by the pilot or imputed from a catalog of trajectories stored in the ship's computer.

For example, the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] had a on-board auto-pilot. The coordinates were send to the [[Snubfighter/Legends|Snubfighter]] from the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar's]] computers, just like in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. The coordinates were received in the central "rat-tail" of the fighter.
